review.reason: The core SI/PI items—channel/interface validation, jitter, PDN, ADC/DAC frontend, and PCB/PCBA SI measurements—are supported by passages [2], [7], and [33], and [46] connects wireless infrastructure digital/power design to relevant T&M tools.
